scripts.build: eleventy && npm run build:clinic && npm run build:flower
scripts.build:clinic: npm ci --prefix demos/clinic-crm && npm run build --prefix demos/clinic-crm
scripts.build:flower: npm ci --prefix demos/flower-crm && npm run build --prefix demos/flower-crm
scripts.dev:site: npx --yes concurrently -k -n site,flower -c blue,magenta "npx eleventy --serve --port 8081" "npm run watch --prefix demos/flower-crm"
